tools_used: WebFetch (supremecourt.gov docket page and letter PDF, two news pages)
helpful: Provisioned petition, BIO and QP text (full, non-truncated) made the split/vehicle read cheap.
The statpack's CVSG cut and the sal-v4 band table gave a clean leakage-safe anchor.
Web fetch of the supremecourt.gov docket surfaced the post-CVSG abeyance letter that changed the forecast.
gaps: A provisioned 'current docket delta' for forward cells (entries after the snapshot cutoff) would have saved four retrieval calls and would be more reliable than a web fetch.
CourtListener MCP carries no proceedings entries for SCOTUS dockets, so it could not answer whether the SG had filed.
fedcourts query has no cvsg or band filter, so priors matching this moment could not be pulled by structured filter.
The statpack publishes no cut for mootness/Munsingwear dispositions or for Rule 46 dismissals, which is the shape this cell needed.
notes: The corpus query returned recent OT2025 rows dominated by interim applications despite the cert scope; the 2020s-era grants list was of limited use as priors for this posture.
